hyperedges.description: Signature Purple, Fraunces display typeface, and Ink/Paper neutral scale together constitute the core visual identity tokens of the OC/DKube design system
Form inputs, buttons, and badges together form the interactive UI component layer of the OC/DKube design system preview
DClaw Finance application is built on top of the FastAPI async backend and is part of the broader DClaw Platform ecosystem
Frontend component is jointly implemented by Next.js and Tailwind CSS as its primary technologies
Backend component is jointly implemented by FastAPI and SQLAlchemy as its primary frameworks
DClawApp CRD deployment relies on DClaw Operator to provision CloudNativePG database alongside the app

The LLM client factory abstracts over both OpenRouter and Anthropic SDK providers, enabling runtime switching via environment variable priority (OPENROUTER_API_KEY takes precedence over ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
OC design tokens (purple palette, typography, ink scale) are applied consistently across both the infographic and presentation deck HTML documents
These three Obsidian notes form a complete documentation triangle — each references the other two as related notes, together covering roadmap/features, architecture/stack, and UI/design system

nodes.label: llm_client.py — Unified LLM Client Factory
nodes.contributor: rationale: Abstracts over OpenRouter (OpenAI SDK) and Anthropic SDK, auto-prefixes model names for OpenRouter, enables zero-code provider swap via env key. Design intent: all LLM calls isolated to services layer only.

nodes.label: One Convergence Design System Vol. 01
nodes.contributor: rationale: Purple #9057FF on white, editorial restraint, enterprise legibility. Sharp 2px corners for brand; 10px radius retained in existing DClaw Finance product for backward compat. Two purples: corporate #9057FF vs product legacy #7030A0.

nodes.label: DClaw Stack — Vertical SaaS App Platform
nodes.norm_label: dclaw stack — vertical saas app platform

nodes.label: Meridian AI Technologies — Demo Fictional Company
nodes.contributor: rationale: Fictional name to prevent confusion with real DKube financials; modeled on DKube enterprise private AI company profile with Indian market pricing.
nodes.norm_label: meridian ai technologies — demo fictional company

nodes.label: INR Currency Formatting — Crore/Lakh Display
nodes.contributor: rationale: All amounts in Indian Rupees with auto-scaling: >=1Cr -> X.XX Cr, >=10L -> X.X L, >=1L -> X.XX L. formatINR() and inrAxisTick() in src/lib/utils.ts.

nodes.label: Graceful AI Degradation Pattern
nodes.contributor: rationale: All AI calls wrapped in try/except so endpoints return data even when LLM unavailable. Prevents AI failures from breaking core financial data access.

nodes.label: Dry-Run Support Pattern for AI Endpoints
nodes.contributor: rationale: All AI endpoints accept ?dry_run=true to return mock data during UI development without spending tokens. Decouples UI work from LLM availability.
nodes.norm_label: dry-run support pattern for ai endpoints

nodes.label: Repository Pattern — DB Access Layer
nodes.contributor: rationale: All DB access through app/repositories/. Prevents AI logic in routers, prevents session leaks, enforces Depends(get_db) dependency injection.

nodes.label: Shared Hub Postgres — Durable Multi-App Database
nodes.contributor: rationale: Hub testbed uses single shared Postgres with 10Gi PVC, auto-initializes all dclaw_* databases on first boot. End-user installs use bundled database instead.
nodes.norm_label: shared hub postgres — durable multi-app database
